fields.System.Title: TRF-104 — Cancel a transfer before dispatch
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a network planner, I want to cancel a transfer that has not left yet, so that the
stock returns to availability at the origin.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an allocated but undispatched transfer, when I cancel it, then every
  • reservation is released and any open pick tasks are cancelled, in one transaction.
  • - Given a dispatched transfer, then cancellation is rejected — the stock is physically
  • on a lorry.
  • - Given a rejected cancellation, then the message explains that a return transfer is the
  • correct route.
  • - Given cancellation, then the reason and acting user are recorded.
  • - Given cancellation, then no reservation for that transfer remains open.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, inventory, outbound |
| Tables | transfer_order, reservation, pick_task |
| Risks | Cancelling after dispatch leaves stock in limbo ([doc 05 WF 12](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)); reservation leak ([doc 09 §5.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant |
